prompts.label: psql connect basics
prompts.text:
Teach psql connection for PostgreSQL beginners.

- psql -h localhost -U postgres -d mydb
- \l list databases, \dt list tables, \d table describe
- \q quit
- PGPASSWORD env vs .pgpass mention

Connect to empty db and run SELECT version();

prompts.label: CREATE TABLE with constraints
prompts.text:
Create users table with constraints.

- id serial or generated always as identity
- email UNIQUE NOT NULL, created_at timestamptz default now()
- CHECK on age or status enum
- Explain constraint names for error messages

Full SQL script create + insert valid/invalid example.

prompts.label: SELECT and JOIN recap
prompts.text:
Recap SELECT with JOINs on orders example schema.

- customers and orders tables
- INNER JOIN customers with orders
- LEFT JOIN find customers without orders
- Filter WHERE and ORDER BY
- Limit offset pagination

Provide schema snippet and three queries.

prompts.label: EXPLAIN ANALYZE query plan
prompts.text:
Use EXPLAIN ANALYZE to read a query plan.

- Run EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT ...
- Identify Seq Scan, Index Scan, cost rows
- When statistics outdated ANALYZE table
- Do not over-optimize tiny tables

Before/after index example referenced.

prompts.label: B-tree indexes when to add
prompts.text:
Explain B-tree indexes for common filters.

- CREATE INDEX ON orders(user_id)
- Columns in WHERE JOIN ORDER BY high selectivity
- Write overhead tradeoff
- Unique index enforces constraint

Show slow query then index improvement with EXPLAIN.

prompts.label: Partial index
prompts.text:
Create partial index for subset of rows.

- CREATE INDEX ON users(email) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
- Smaller index faster for hot subset
- Query must match predicate to use index
- Use case: active records only

SQL example and matching query.

prompts.label: JSONB query operators
prompts.text:
Query JSONB column metadata in PostgreSQL.

- Insert row with jsonb {"tags":["a","b"], "score": 10}
- -> ->> operators, @> containment
- GIN index on jsonb_path_ops mention for scale

Three SELECT examples filtering JSON.

prompts.label: Arrays and unnest
prompts.text:
Work with PostgreSQL array columns.

- tags TEXT[] column insert '{sql,postgres}'
- WHERE 'sql' = ANY(tags)
- unnest(tags) join to normalize for reporting
- When separate junction table better

Examples inserting and querying.

prompts.label: Window functions ROW_NUMBER
prompts.text:
Rank rows per group with window functions.

- ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dept ORDER BY salary DESC)
- Top employee per department query pattern
- Contrast with GROUP BY aggregate
- SUM() OVER running total teaser

Sample employees table SQL.

prompts.label: Recursive CTE teaser
prompts.text:
Introduce recursive CTE for hierarchy.

- employees manager_id tree
- WITH RECURSIVE starting roots union join children
- Select depth and path array optional
- Limit recursion depth safety

Query listing org chart levels conceptually.

prompts.label: Transactions and isolation
prompts.text:
Explain transactions and isolation levels.

- BEGIN; UPDATE; COMMIT; ROLLBACK;
- Read committed default vs repeatable read phantom
- Short lock contention example
- Application pattern: one transaction per request

SQL demo transferring balance between accounts.

prompts.label: COPY import and export
prompts.text:
Bulk load CSV with COPY.

- COPY users FROM '/path/users.csv' CSV HEADER
- \copy meta-command in psql for client path
- Export COPY TO STDOUT for backup slice
- Delimiter NULL encoding options

Sample csv two rows and table definition.

prompts.label: pg_dump and restore
prompts.text:
Backup and restore database with pg_dump.

- pg_dump -Fc mydb > backup.dump custom format
- pg_restore -d newdb backup.dump
- Plain sql pg_dump for small dbs
- Schedule backups and test restore habit

Commands only — no cloud specifics.

prompts.label: Connection pooling PgBouncer
prompts.text:
Introduce PgBouncer for connection pooling.

- Why too many app connections hurt Postgres
- Pool modes session transaction statement headline
- App connects to pgbouncer port 6432
- Prepared statements caveat in transaction pooling

When managed RDS proxy similar role.

prompts.label: Full text search tsvector
prompts.text:
Basic full text search with tsvector.

- ALTER TABLE articles ADD COLUMN tsv tsvector
- Update tsv from to_tsvector('english', title || body)
- GIN index on tsv
- WHERE tsv @@ plainto_tsquery('postgres tutorial')

Minimal searchable articles example.

prompts.label: UUID with gen_random_uuid
prompts.text:
Use UUID primary keys in PostgreSQL.

- CREATE EXTENSION pgcrypto; gen_random_uuid()
- id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
- Compare serial vs uuid tradeoffs
- Index bloat mention acceptable at moderate scale

Create table and insert without specifying id.

prompts.label: Migrations Flyway or Alembic
prompts.text:
Outline schema migrations with Flyway or Alembic on Postgres.

- Versioned SQL files V1__init.sql
- Alembic revision autogenerate from SQLAlchemy mention
- Never edit applied migration
- Rollback strategy

Beginner workflow from empty db to v2 column add.

prompts.label: Row level security intro
prompts.text:
Introduce RLS for multi-tenant apps.

- ALTER TABLE orders ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
- CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant')::int)
- Set setting per connection in app middleware
- Bypass for superuser caution

Conceptual SQL — explain leak if policy missing.

prompts.label: VACUUM and ANALYZE maintenance
prompts.text:
Explain VACUUM ANALYZE and autovacuum for beginners.

- Dead tuples from UPDATE DELETE
- Autovacuum monitors bloat headline
- Manual VACUUM ANALYZE after big delete
- pg_stat_user_tables columns to watch

When not to panic about autovacuum noise.

prompts.label: PostgreSQL vs SQLite when to pick
prompts.text:
When choose Postgres over SQLite?

- Concurrent writers, network access, advanced types → Postgres
- Local dev single file embedded → SQLite
- Heroku/Fly postgres vs file sqlite
- Migration path sqlite dev postgres prod pattern

Decision bullets for side project vs SaaS.
